newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Aero in Malaysia auto venture talks.
newsitem.headline: China Aero in Malaysia auto venture talks.

text.p: China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it has just started negotiation with an independent third party in Malaysia regarding cooperation in automobile manufacturing.
But no agreement had been arrived and such negotiation might or might not proceed, the company said in a statement.

China Aerospace, which makes and distributes electronics and plastic products, said it was not aware of any reasons for the recent increases in the price and turnover of the shares and warrants of its company. Its shares eased HK$0.05 to HK$2.10 in morning trade on Thursday. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
